prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1496; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a side impact at an intersection. The damage to the driver's side is largely consistent with the reported collision, with crumpled rear door panel, cracked rear quarter glass and scuffed sill trim. Repair plan calls for replacing the door shell, reinforcing the pillar, refinishing adjacent panels and recalibrating the side curtain sensor. Labor hours submitted match the scope of the damage. Invoices reviewed show no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, so the repairs appear limited to this loss.
